analysis: Reviewed the two base_text units of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (base lines 822-1671). The PR, per the patch excerpt and changed ranges, is documentation-only. It updates the 'Last updated' date, says video input may be constant or variable frame rate, adds a startup warning about GLM-5.3-Flash GPU wired-memory limits, and adds status/doctor wording changes (new base ranges near 946 and 1603, head ranges 949-952, 1100-1130, 1615, 1641). The excerpt is truncated, so the full changes at head are not visible. The base text I examined covers stop/restart drain, status/doctor diagnostics, logout and unenroll, the report command and the fan helper CLI. It also covers the provider.toml keys and the paths table. This text is unchanged and only describes behavior; I found no security-relevant claim that changes a control. The base text includes a malformed table row at line 1603 (`[provider] memory_reserve_gb | 4 | ...`). The patch touches that row, and the likely fix is cosmetic. No code, auth, attestation, encryption, cache-storage or fan-helper behavior changes in the visible evidence. This does not weaken T-041, T-053, TB-010 or TB-011. The variable-frame-rate video claim touches T-050 (inline video plaintext in temp files) only as documentation. The actual implementation is not supplied, so I cannot confirm that the VFR decode path still avoids plaintext temp files. This is an unverified contract, not a finding. The remaining uncertainty is the new head content (the doctor/status additions at head 949-952 and 1100-1130 and the wired-memory section), which is not visible in the supplied units.
